description: KiwiRail publishes railway centrelines with each polyline representing a track asset. The source distinguishes main lines, yard tracks, loops and links and identifies nearby locations. Private sidings and privately owned track are excluded. The stated accuracy is about 0.5 m in New Zealand Transverse Mercator. The provider explicitly limits use to mapping and excludes survey-accurate CAD design, true track geometry and elevation. Its simplified NZ Railway Network is a separate related resource. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
